name: Clara Holt
traitText: Once per round, ignore the first Sanity loss from an Event card.
bio: Clara once believed the dead stayed silent — until a book in the university archives began to hum. She followed the whispers to Harrowgate Manor, convinced that buried truths lay just beneath the surface of reality. Clara clings to logic, even as the world begins to fray.

name: Gideon Marsh
traitText: Once per turn, reroll a failed Flee attempt.
bio: Retired in disgrace after a string of 'delusional' reports, Gideon knows what lurks in the dark corners of forgotten places. He's not here for glory — only to ensure no one else dies like his partner did. His fists are steady, but his dreams are not.

name: Lucille Voss
traitText: Once per round, you may look at the top card of the Encounter Deck. (In place of an action)
bio: Lucille hears what others cannot. Her talents once made her a parlor trick — now, they guide her toward something ancient. She no longer questions whether the voices are real — only whether she can trust them.

name: Dr. Alan Graves
traitText: When another player in an adjacent space regains Health, they regain +1 additional Health.
bio: After the war, Alan turned to experimental medicine to escape the screams. Now he travels with a bag full of vials and secrets — seeking redemption or perhaps distraction, in wounds that bleed less than his own.

name: Marion Blake
traitText: Once per turn, after Investigating, you may move 1 additional space for free.
bio: A nosy reporter turned self-proclaimed detective, Marion's intuition is her greatest weapon — or her undoing. She's not here by accident. Something in the case files whispered her name.

name: Silas Finch
traitText: You may spend 2 Clue Tokens at any time to regain 1 Sanity. (In place of an action)
bio: Silas trades in artifacts no one dares speak of. Each object in his possession whispers its own truth, and some whisper too loudly. His mind is a museum of horrors — and he's always seeking the next exhibit.
